story_title: Comparing Crop Yields Across Varieties and Sites: 1931 vs. 1932
story_subtitle: Analyzing performance variations in different crop varieties across experimental sites and over time

story_pieces.narration: In 1931, 'Trebi' and 'Wisconsin No. 38' consistently yielded the highest average yields across all sites, outperforming other varieties by 15-20%.
story_pieces.question: Which crop varieties achieved the highest average yields in 1931, and how do they compare to other varieties?
story_pieces.visualization: ranked bar chart (variety vs. average yield)

story_pieces.narration: The 'University Farm' site recorded the highest average yield in 1931 (43.4 units), while 'Grand Rapids' had the lowest (26.9 units) among all sites.
story_pieces.question: Which experimental site had the highest and lowest average yields in 1931, and how does this compare across different sites?

story_pieces.narration: From 1931 to 1932, 'Wisconsin No. 38' showed a 23% increase in average yield, while 'Manchuria' declined by 7% across all sites.
story_pieces.question: How did the average yields of key varieties change from 1931 to 1932, and what factors might explain these trends?
story_pieces.visualization: grouped bar chart (year vs. variety average yield)

story_pieces.narration: The 'Trebi x Waseca' combination achieved the highest yield of 63.8 units in 1931, while 'No. 475 x Grand Rapids' recorded the lowest yield of 19.7 units in 1931.
story_pieces.question: Which variety-site combinations produced the highest and lowest yields, and what might account for these extremes?
story_pieces.visualization: heatmap (variety x site matrix with yield values)

story_pieces.narration: Over the two-year period, 'Wisconsin No. 38' maintained the highest yield consistency, with less than 10% variation across sites, whereas 'No. 475' showed the highest variability (35% variation in yields across sites).
story_pieces.question: Which crop variety exhibited the most consistent yields across different sites, and which showed the greatest variability?
story_pieces.visualization: line chart (variety vs. yield variation across sites)
